text.p: Asia Equity Ltd on Wednesday rated Electricity Generating Plc a "buy" following the private power producer's good performance in 1996.

"Electricity Generating's full result was in line with our forecasts, despite including a forex loss of 140 million baht - meaning operating profit was better than forecast," Asia Equity said in a report.
At 0753 GMT, Electricity Generating shares were up 0.50 baht to 59.50.
Electricity Generating posted a net profit of 1.55 billion baht in 1996 against 940 million baht a year ago.
Its debt was also declining steadily since the transfer of the Khanom power plant from the state Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand last June to Electricity Generating, it said.
As of December 31, Electricity Generating's debt totalled 18.9 billion baht, while its gearing ratio was at 1.2 times, Asia Equity said.
